extensionDescription.message: Hide Thunderbird to the system tray instead of closing it. Tray icon with unread counter and menu for KDE Plasma, GNOME (AppIndicator), XFCE; works on Wayland and X11, including Snap and Flatpak.

optionInterceptClose.message: Hide to the tray when the main window is closed (✕)

optionInterceptCloseHint.message: Use Ctrl+Q, File › Quit or “Quit” in the tray menu to exit Thunderbird.

optionMinimizeToTray.message: Hide to the tray when the main window is minimized

optionMinimizeToTrayHint.message: Works with Thunderbird’s own title bar buttons; some Wayland compositors do not report minimizing done by the window manager.

optionStartInTray.message: Start Thunderbird hidden in the tray

optionShowUnreadCount.message: Show the number of unread messages on the tray icon

optionUnreadScopeAll.message: All folders except Trash, Junk, Sent, Drafts, Templates and Archives

statusTrayUnavailable.message: No system tray was found (StatusNotifierItem / AppIndicator). The window will not be hidden until a tray becomes available. On GNOME install the “AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support” extension.

kwinIntro.message: Wayland does not allow applications to position their own windows, so after the window is shown from the tray KWin places it according to its placement policy (often centered). A KWin window rule makes KDE remember the position of the Thunderbird main window.

kwinImportStep2Hint.message: Or search for “Window Rules” in the application launcher.

kwinImportStep3.message: Click “Import…”, select the downloaded file, then click “Apply”. The rule takes effect the next time the window appears.
